seo.title: BLD Southeast 2026 - Washington, DC | September 16-17, 2026
seo.description: Sept. 16-17, 2026. Join B Corps & mission-driven professionals in Washington, DC to learn & connect at the BLD Southeast conference.

hero.headline: The future of business is built by those who dare to care, cultivating legacy through thriving communities.

about.heading: Back for our sixth year
about.body: We're back for our sixth year of BLD Southeast, and this year we're bringing our impactful event to the dynamic, historic, and influential nation's capital: Washington, D.C.

whyAttend.heading: Why attend BLD Southeast
whyAttend.intro: Two days built for people who believe business can be a force for good — and want the tools, network, and community to prove it.

benefits.title: Learn from conscious-business practitioners
benefits.description: Sessions and conversations drawn from B Corps and mission-driven leaders putting people-and-planet practices to work every day.

benefits.title: Connect with the B Corp community
benefits.description: Meet founders, operators, and advocates from across the Southeast and beyond who are building companies around a stronger bottom line.

benefits.title: Support local B Local communities
benefits.description: Every ticket helps fund the regional B Local organizations that keep the conscious-business movement growing where you live.

agenda.heading: Agenda
agenda.placeholderNote: Full agenda coming soon — check back for Day 1 (Sept 16) and Day 2 (Sept 17) session details.
